name: Counting with ADD: every scan, or once per press

tags.name: EveryScan
tags.comment: adds 1 on every scan Click is held

tags.name: PerPress
tags.comment: adds 1 once per press of Click

rungs.comment: A normally open contact: ADD runs on every scan Click is held, 100 times a second.
A rising-edge contact -|P|-: ADD runs only in the one scan when Click turns on, so one press adds 1.
